patterns.message: Shared packages and the worker also run on Node (ADR 0006): use standard Web or Node APIs.
A Module imports nothing from WebCraft but @webcraft/module-sdk (ADR 0024).
A Module reaches the database, the server and the outside world only through @webcraft/module-sdk, which also gives it Drizzle's builders and Zod.

deniedGlobals.fetch: A Module calls outside hosts with context.http, which checks them against its manifest.
deniedGlobals.XMLHttpRequest: A Module calls outside hosts with context.http, which checks them against its manifest.
deniedGlobals.WebSocket: A Module calls outside hosts with context.http, which checks them against its manifest.
deniedGlobals.process: A Module never reads the server's environment: everything it needs comes through its context.
deniedGlobals.Bun: A Module runs on Bun and Node alike, and later in a sandbox: it uses only its context.
deniedGlobals.require: A Module imports nothing from WebCraft but @webcraft/module-sdk (ADR 0024).
deniedGlobals.globalThis: A Module reaches nothing through the global object: everything it needs comes through its context.
